title: Amazon Quick Official Agent
description: Schema for an official agent definition (agents/{category}/{name}/agent.json). The format is the app's Agent Export JSON with three catalog-only additions (schema_version, author, icon). Field limits mirror the in-product agent limits.

schema_version.description: Agent file format version. v1 is the only accepted value.

name.description: Display name shown in the catalog and the agent list.

description.description: One-paragraph description of what the agent does.

welcome_message.description: Greeting shown when a chat with the agent opens.

starter_prompts.description: Up to 3 suggested first prompts, each at most 100 characters.

capabilities.description: Built-in capabilities the agent uses, e.g. ["WEB_SEARCH"].

skills.description: Official skills from this catalog, by their '{category}/{name}' path under skills/ (no ids). Each maps to a skill 'path' in catalog.json.

author.description: Human-readable author/publisher, same rules as a skill's frontmatter author. Optional.

icon.description: Relative path to the agent icon inside its own folder, SVG only (same rules and 5 KB cap as skill icons). Optional.
